extensionDescription.message: Connect an MCP agent to Chrome or Brave to open, read, and control tabs in a separate group for each conversation.

rotateConfirmation.message: Rotate the token and revoke current access?

configurationError.message: Check the bridge address and browser name.

controlPaused.message: Control is paused. Click Resume in the extension.

bridgePath.message: Use /browser as the bridge URL path.

restartAgent.message: Start a new agent session to load the BetterBrowser tab group tools.

invalidDestination.message: Use an HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials in the URL.

missingTabId.message: The browser did not return an ID for the new tab.

tabOpened.message: Tab $id$ opened and selected in the BetterBrowser group.

readyToOpen.message: Ready to open the first tab of this session with open or navigate.

groupStatus.message: BetterBrowser group. Tab count: $count$. Selected tab: $id$.

notSessionTab.message: This tab does not belong to the session. Use tabs to list its tabs or open to create one.

tabLoading.message: The tab is loading. Try read again shortly.

navigateToPage.message: Use navigate to open an HTTP or HTTPS page.

documentChanged.message: The document changed. Read the tab again.

pageChanged.message: The page changed during the action. Read the tab again.

pageLoading.message: The page is loading. Try reading it again shortly.

expiredReference.message: Reference expired. Read the page again.

interactionChanged.message: Control or the document changed. Check the tab before continuing.

formChanged.message: The page changed while filling the form. Check the fields.
